text: Over the past 30 days, visitors have frequently noted issues with crowding, which affected their ability to fully experience the exhibits and navigate the space comfortably. Several reviews mentioned confusion or frustration with the timed entry system and the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance, with no option to buy on-site. Parking was also a common concern, particularly due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, some criticized the heavy reliance on AI in the displays. The gift shop received negative comments for its limited selection of library-related items.

windows.7: Visitor feedback over the past week shows no critical issues but highlights some areas for attention. Comments related to parking and food and beverage options appeared three times each, suggesting these could be reviewed for improvement. Visitor flow and conduct on the grounds were mentioned twice, indicating some concerns in these areas. Most praise focused on the interactive exhibits, architecture, and interpretation, with families and rooftop experiences also noted positively. Overall, the average rating remains high at 4.93 from 46 reviews.
